notes.title: Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair [DEVLOG #1] - The First Light
notes.content:
Hey! 🙌

This is Artur Mikołajczyk, the man behind the Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair! I'm here today to tell you about the beginnings of Bulbware and how it all started. Enjoy reading! 💡

🟨 The beginnings of our dreams  🟨


Let's go back to our school days, when the Internet was still mainly connected via noisy modems, and dreams of having your own video game were something almost magical for teenagers. It was then, in 2001, that I met Szymon Łukasik through a mutual friend. We quickly discovered that we shared the same passion: we wanted to create our own point & click adventure game. Full of enthusiasm, we started working on our first project, but unfortunately, our lack of experience and knowledge meant that our ambitious idea ended up only in notes, sketches, and a simple prototype.  



Life went on, and for a while, we each went our separate ways. I gained experience in the gaming industry, learning on real commercial projects, while Szymon developed his skills in the world of advertising graphics, becoming a highly regarded illustrator. Despite our different paths, we still dreamed of the same thing – a game that we ourselves would want to play. 



After many years, we got back in touch. It quickly became clear that our old plans were still alive. Our conversations turned into a concrete plan: we would create a studio where we could realize our ideas without compromise. And so, in 2015, Bulbware was born.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41040719/899b0e89b3afbb27bfc4a8d586355a0f2a975802.png"]Bulbware (from the left - Szymon Łukasik, in the middle - our sound designer - Piotr Surmacz and me- Artur Mikołajczyk)


🟨 Bulb Boy and other projects 🟨


The first fruit of our collaboration was a prototype game, which eventually evolved into the full-fledged Bulb Boy that you know so well. Our little glowing hero quickly won the hearts of gamers and the interest of the media with his cuteness and grotesque horror. This success allowed us to port the title to various platforms and feel that we were truly creating something special.



The following years were not only spent working on the next project – Poopdie. At that time, we created a number of internal game prototypes that never saw the light of day, such as Dark Street, Fishy Island, and Little Goldar. These are just some of the ideas that were born at that time. They never saw the light of day, but each of them was a step towards what Bulbware was to become...



In 2020, the decision was made: we are returning to the world of the glowing boy. This is how work on Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair began. However, life likes to surprise us – personal problems arose that slowed down the development of the project and naturally led to a split in the team. It should be noted that the split was amicable and friendly, but it still meant big changes.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41040719/284800c728e310be4ea60cbadaf43797f461eda1.png"](Fishy Island)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41040719/a8a89cfb47ddec7f2918380a19cd72327345f942.png"](Dark Street)


🟨 Bulbware today and tomorrow  🟨


Since 2024, Bulbware has been a one-man studio. I was left alone – and I decided with full conviction to finish what we had started together. Today, looking back on all these years of work, I can say that I am very happy that Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair is in its final stages and that you will be able to play it on October 23, 2025! 



I hope that on that special night I will be able to say to myself: I did it!
[hr][/hr]

And that's it! Remember, this first devlog is just an introduction. In the next ones, I'll tell you more about the game itself, its atmosphere, the development process, and what awaits players when Bulb Boy turns on his light again. 😎

 Take care and remember... May the light bulb be with you and guide you through the darkness! 💡[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair is coming to Steam on October 23, 2025!
notes.content:
Hello there, from Bulb Boy fans! 💡

We have some good news today that we wanted to share with you! This year's Halloween will be truly special because your favorite lught bulb hero will come back and get into new adventures soon before the festivities begin! Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair - has the official release date!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41040719/666cc5b0c51615dc0980a8954a5b33f9d71ecbb0.png"]
The next chapter of Bulb Boy's story will land on Steam on October 23, 2025! 💛


Spread the news with your friends, family, pets (just like... everyone!) and go see the new trailer we made specially for this annoucement! 




[previewyoutube="cO3ZxLslwXk;full"][/previewyoutube]


Two more things you might be interested in!

▶️ We just pulled out old demo from Steam because... A brand new version is coming soon! We'll let you know about the details but keep your eyes peeled on our socials!

▶️ We also just launched a big, pre release giveaway where you have a chance to win free copy of the game, after the release! => Just enter HERE!

notes.title: Bulb Boy 1 discounted, Bad Cheese out now & bundle... Fresh news!
notes.content:
Hey there, Bulb Boy fans! 💡Today we got bunch of fresh news for you so...   

Without further ado, let's get right to it! 📰


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9917402/0f40fabc3caaa771ba0c0cd6ca7c409b65187b10.png"]


Starting today, from September 1️⃣st til 1️⃣5️⃣th (so for two weeks) Bulb Boy 1 will be discounted -84%!
What's the occasion, you may ask? This has something to do with few things.  

Firstly, Bad Cheese - a psychological horror inspired by 1920s animation and made by Simon Lukasik - co creator of Bulb Boy - is out now!


So we decided to celebrate together, resulting in the ‘Boys in distress’ bundle. The rule is simple — if you already have Bulb Boy in your library, you'll get an additional 10% discount on Bad Cheese in the bundle, on top of the launch discount! 🎮


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9917402/bda0ff53af68c6ff87997f026a9a050b8b8ca725.png"]



Secondly, this solid and quite long price reduction for Bulb Boy is linked to the fact that... This October, BB will turn 10! We have prepared a few surprises for this title, but a decent discount on the game as a prelude sounds good, now, doesn't it? 🎂



(Oh the time flies...) 


And thirdly... The most important thing ⚠️Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair is closer and closer. If you are hungry for info about its premiere, set your clock alarms on September 5, 5PM CEST / 8AM PDT. That's all we can say.

Let's the hype train gain that speed!  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9917402/b1ac9a15ad1c723247c25107f53a84d91954f8a1.png"]

If you are interested in more information about Bulb Boy or Bad Cheese, check out social media links ⤵️

Fearedmic - Instagram

See you and...
May the light of your bulb, shine bright in the dark! 💡

notes.title: Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair will participate in The ANZ Indie Showcase 2025!
notes.content:
We are excited to annouce that Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair will take part in this year's edition of The ANZ Indie Showcase - an event celebrating games created in Australia! 🦘


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41040719/2dd8917e9b73b5dc319e6046f765b97e1bdc12c7.png"]





The showcase will include livestream on The Indie Brew YouTube channel, special section on the website and Steam event! 



And it will all take place on September 5 at 7:30pm AEST / 11:30 CEST ✅
